clauses.text: Each claim line is assessed against the first diagnosis its pointers reference. If that diagnosis does not support the service, the line is denied with reason code 11.

clauses.section_heading: Correcting the diagnosis on a claim
clauses.text: A corrected claim may link or add a supporting diagnosis only when the record for the date of service documents that diagnosis. A diagnosis recorded only at a later visit may not be used.

MRI of the knee (73721) is supported by examination findings that suggest a meniscal or ligament injury, such as a positive McMurray or Lachman test, mechanical locking or giving way; or by knee pain that continues after at least 4 weeks of conservative treatment.

MRI of the lumbar spine (72148) is supported by low back pain with a neurological deficit, bowel or bladder dysfunction, a history of cancer, fever or suspected infection, or significant trauma; or by low back pain that continues after at least 6 weeks of conservative treatment.

clauses.section_heading: Aspiration or injection of a large joint
clauses.text: Aspiration or injection of a large joint (20610) is supported by a diagnosis of arthritis or effusion of the joint treated. It is not supported by a diagnosis that does not concern that joint.
A denial with reason code 50 reflects a clinical judgement by the plan. It may be challenged only by an appeal under policy QUIL-APL, which a plan clinician decides.
